Time as an Index: What It Would Take to Look Up Tomorrow

What would happen to digital security if tomorrow's calculations could be looked up like a table today?

[31 Machine-Checked Proofs · 0 Time Shortcuts]

1/3 Inside a mathematical time loop, almost every digital lock would break at once except a one-time secret pad.

2/3 In known physics, no quantum trick, analog circuit, or reported anomaly sends readable answers backward in time.

3/3 Every fast lookup of a future answer is work paid upfront, which fresh random values defeat immediately.
